description: This file defines the MenuContextCardInjector class, which injects and manages a custom context menu card in a macOS application menu. It handles cache management, menu item insertion, and UI updates for displaying session-related information within the menu.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A controller class responsible for injecting a custom context card view into an macOS menu, managing cache data, and handling menu display lifecycle events.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a provided status item, establishing delegate and initializing cache warming.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the menu is about to open, including injecting the custom card view.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Cleans up when the menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Delegates menu update requests to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Determines the confinement rectangle for the menu, potentially constrained by delegate implementation.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the cached session data, handling errors and rate limiting.

methods.name: cachedView
methods.description: Constructs the SwiftUI view displaying session rows or loading/error states.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows
methods.description: Async function to load current session rows filtered by activity window timestamps.

methods.name: findInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the appropriate index to insert the custom card in the menu item list.

methods.name: initialCardWidth
methods.description: Calculates the initial width of the card based on available menu widths and fallback values.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Captures and caches the menu width for consistent display across menu openings.
